card.name: Bortezomib label dosing text
card.fires_on: Punctuation, small linking words and word starts inside bortezomib label passages on dosing and combination therapy with melphalan. Typical spots are the decimal point in 1.3 mg/m2, the slash in 10 9/L, and an opening parenthesis after melphalan.
